people.imagined: The gate at the hour the mist comes in. He stands so still in the grey that the viewer almost walks past him; then the eyes move. He has been standing there a long time with the paper of the month's page folded in his sleeve and has no wish to be seen.
people.subject: The moment: standing motionless in thick mist at a gate, almost merged with it, he lets only his eyes turn toward the viewer. Face: an utterly unremarkable thin grey face, the kind forgotten at once: skin the colour of ash, narrow cheeks, a small straight nose, thin colourless lips, eyebrows so pale they nearly vanish; pale grey eyes that give nothing back. Hair: thin grey hair combed flat and tied in a small knot, held by a slender silver pin. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, held very still. Clothing: the sect head's richest robes, three layers of pure mist-grey gauze over grey-green silk that dissolve into the mist at the hem, crossed collars embroidered with silver mist curls, wide sleeves hanging in long folds, a silver lantern pin at the collar; a wide round hat of fine bamboo on a silk cord, plain and without badge. Hands and objects: both hands hidden in his wide sleeves; beside him a pole whose top holds a small black-pine lantern with horn panes, the candle dim. Power: the mist seems to breathe out of his sleeves, a faint blue-green glimmer of Water and Wood in it, so that he is made of the same stuff as the air. Background: heavy white mist and the faint grey outline of a stone gatepost, motes of pale light drifting. Light: soft silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a faint moonlit rim along the gauze, no hard shadows. Expression: blank and watchful, practised at being overlooked.

people.imagined: A night camp at the Bobtail ridge's foot. He is laughing at something a guard said, head thrown back, the axe across his knees, and the laugh carries across the clearing; then he catches himself and picks up a child's primer from his lap, as if it were a tally.
people.subject: The moment: seated by a camp fire at night, he laughs hugely with his head back, then glances down at a small book on his knee. Face: a huge laugh, mouth wide open showing a missing upper tooth and grey in his beard; a heavy, scarred face, a thick white scar cutting through the left eyebrow and another across a flattened broken nose, a thick neck, small bright dark eyes creased shut. Hair: coarse black streaked with grey in a messy knot held by a plain silver pin, a few strands loose. Body: massive, thick as a barrel, short neck, arms like beams. Clothing: an elder's robe of grey-green silk with mist-grey gauze over it, the crossed collars embroidered in silver mist curls and thrown open across his great chest, wide sleeves pushed back to the elbow, a dark-grey sash hung with a jade pendant and a silver lantern pin; a wide bamboo hat hanging at his back on its silk cord. Hands and objects: an axe with a pale lynx-bone haft across his knees, the head dark and curved; on his thigh a thin child's primer with a faded blue cover, open. Power: a faint green-blue haze of Wood and Water qi rises with the sparks from the fire, thicker about his shoulders. Background: dark pines in drifting mist, a pale pole lantern, floating motes of light. Light: orange firelight from below and the left, a cool silvery moonlit rim on the grey gauze. Expression: boisterous, then caught out.

people.imagined: The lantern cellar at night. She is trimming a green-paned lantern and has looked up at a stranger on the stair, giving them a second long look; ink on her fingers, a lamp wick burning low. She is deciding whether to be kind to a stranger or add them to the ledger.
people.subject: The moment: in a lantern cellar, she holds a green-paned lantern up beside her face and looks at the viewer a second time, harder. Face: ink stains plainly visible on her long fingers and the heel of her right hand near her cheek, dark blue-black; a long, severe, handsome face, high cheekbones, a long straight nose, thin firm mouth; dark eyes narrowed in suspicion, fine lines of wear round them. Hair: black with a streak of white at the right temple, drawn into a tight high knot with a silver pin shaped like a small lantern. Body: tall, narrow, upright and stiff. Clothing: the robes of a true-transmission disciple, layered grey-green silk with a high crossed collar and a pale mist-grey gauze over-robe, silver mist curls embroidered along the borders, sleeve cuffs pinned back with small jade clips, a sash hung with a jade pendant and a silver tassel. Hands and objects: the lantern has four panes of green glass in a fine dark frame, its light tinting the left side of her face green; her left hand grips the pole. Power: a thin green glow of Wood qi gathers round the lantern and runs along her inked fingers like a living thread. Background: a blurred stone cellar wall lined with shelves of lanterns, a narrow stone stair climbing behind her with a row of small lights at different heights, drifting motes. Light: green lantern glow and a soft silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: suspicious, intent, unforgiving.

people.imagined: Spring, holding the lantern for the head at the gate. She smiles at everyone and listens; her fingers watch the head's hands and she counts the turns. She has just heard something she will repeat.
people.subject: The moment: holding a lantern aloft by the gate, she smiles warmly at the viewer, listening, while her eyes drift to something just out of frame. Face: a comely, round, gentle face, smooth cheeks with a dimple, soft full lips in a ready smile, large clear dark eyes under delicate arched brows, and a tiny mole beside the mouth; she looks like someone everyone confides in. Hair: glossy black in a low knot at the nape with a single white pear-wood pin and a silver ribbon. Body: slim, graceful, standing straight. Clothing: an inner disciple's layered silk, a pale grey-green under-robe with a crossed collar, a grey-green over-robe whose hem dissolves into mist, silver mist curls along the borders, a dark-green sash with a jade pendant, wide sleeves falling in long folds; no badge. Hands and objects: both hands lift a pole-lantern with horn panes in a dark frame; her fingers on the pole are bent in a counting position, thumb pressing three fingertips in turn. Power: a few pale blue motes of Water qi drift up from her sleeves and curl around the lantern. Background: a blurred wooden gate wreathed in mist, a small carved mist-seal on the gatepost, and in the mist the faint grey figure of the head working at the array. Light: warm lantern gold from the upper left against cool moonlit grey, a soft rim on her hair. Expression: sweet, attentive, with something held back behind it.

people.imagined: At the port road beside a cart, he is promising a merchant something cheerful and it comes out smoothly. The silver tooth shows in the half-light; he does not know how obvious it is.
people.subject: The moment: at a roadside cart in morning haze, he grins broadly and spreads a hand as if offering a deal, leaning slightly toward the viewer. Face: a gleaming silver tooth plainly shown in the middle of his grin, one upper incisor bright as a coin among the yellow ones; a wide, pliant face, flat cheeks with a shine of sweat, a bulbous nose with fine veins, a thin little moustache, thin arched eyebrows, quick merry eyes that do not quite meet yours; a few chins. Hair: black, greased back under a wide bamboo hat tipped back on his head. Body: heavy, round-shouldered, a carter's posture. Clothing: a cheerful, fatter version of the sect's grey-green: layered silk robes of grey-green with a wine-brown inner collar, silver mist curls embroidered on the borders, wide sleeves whose cuffs are stained with fish brine, a jade pendant and a fat string of copper coins hung from the sash, a small purse tied beside it; straw sandals. Hands and objects: his open right palm held out; the left holds the rope of a pole lantern. Background: a covered cart, stacked wicker baskets of dried silver fish, a shaggy brown ox, a lamp post at a crossroad vanishing into pearly mist. Light: soft pearly haze with a warm silver shine along the silver tooth and the coins, a gentle glow on the edge of his sleeves. Expression: easy, ingratiating, calculating.

people.imagined: At a crossroads at dusk, lighting the lantern on its post. A door slams somewhere down the road and he flinches visibly, then pretends to be adjusting the wick.
people.subject: The moment: at a crossroads lantern post at dusk, he flinches and jerks his head toward a sound out of frame, the lighting taper still lit in his hand. Face: a flinch: eyes snapped wide, whites showing all round, mouth tight, one shoulder hunched to the ear; a gaunt, hollow-cheeked, lined face, long drooping nose, thin grey stubble, deep dark rings under the eyes. Hair: dry grey, thin on top, a few long strands damp across his brow, bound in a small knot with a plain silver pin. Body: thin, wiry, coiled like a spring. Clothing: an inner disciple's grey-green silk robe, crossed collars buttoned tight to the chin and embroidered in faint silver mist curls, wide sleeves, two dark stains of lamp oil down the front, knuckles scraped raw from the lantern chains; a plain bamboo hat pushed back on a silk cord. Hands and objects: a long lighting taper with a tiny flame in his right hand; the left holds a half-open lantern of frosted horn panes and a bundle of small tallies on knotted cord at his belt. Background: behind him a tall post carrying five lanterns on iron arms, each pane of a different pale colour, and four roads running into the dusk between dark tea bushes, faint motes drifting. Light: the flame lights half of the face hot orange while the other half stays in cold blue spirit-light, from the lower right, the whites of his eyes shining. Expression: tense, watchful, ready for betrayal.

people.imagined: Leading the salt-fish carts at dawn. A child is walking the road alone; he has stopped the whole line to give her a rice ball and has paid her fee. He is calm and does not make a thing of it; rice crumbs are on his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: on a misty road at dawn, he leans down from the lead cart and holds out a rice ball in his open hand, smiling gently. Face: a kind, broad, weathered face, round and tanned, with soft crow's-feet and laugh-lines, a big warm nose, a gentle slow smile; small lively eyes like a bird's; rice crumbs clinging at the corner of his mouth and in his beard. Hair: grey-black, in a thin knot, half covered by a wide bamboo hat pushed back. Body: stout, sturdy, easy in the seat of the cart. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful silk, a faded blue under-robe and an open grey-green silk robe with a single modest silver mist curl at the hem, wide sleeves with rice crumbs in the folds, a copper coin on a cord at his neck. Hands and objects: in his right hand a small white rice ball wrapped in a bamboo leaf; at the cart's side a lantern on a pole, still lit. Background: a line of carts disappearing into mist, each with a small lantern, a small barefoot girl with a stick at the roadside. Light: pale gold dawn from the upper left shining through drifting mist, a soft glow on his sleeve. Expression: an easy, unbothered kindness; he seems to have all morning for the child.

people.imagined: The Forest of Lost Mist, a morning. She has just laid a fresh bank of mist and stands in the middle of it, hand lifted, as the white closes behind her. She has noticed her pegs have moved again and her fog-coloured eyes have narrowed.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a swirling bank of mist she has just laid, one hand raised, she looks straight at the viewer with cold appraisal. Face: unusual pale grey eyes the colour of fog, nearly colourless, wide and cold; a narrow, sharp, arrogant face, a thin straight nose, a high forehead, a small tight smirk; skin very pale, nearly translucent, with fine blue veins at the temples; lashes so fair they almost vanish. Hair: black, in a long high ponytail bound with silver ribbon and a pin, a few loose strands. Body: slim, straight, chin high. Clothing: an inner disciple's finest silk, a close-fitted grey-green robe with black-piped crossed collars and a dove-grey silk lining, a sheer mist-grey gauze over-robe lifting in the mist, silver mist curls on the sleeves, a narrow dark sash; a thin silver chain at her throat with a small wooden mist-peg charm; fine black silk gloves, the left with a cut finger. Hands and objects: her right hand raised palm-out with white mist curling between the fingers; at her feet three short dark pegs with cords set in a precise triangle. Power: pale blue-silver qi of Water and green motes of Wood swirl about her raised hand, strong for her age. Background: dark trunks losing themselves in fog. Light: no hard shadows, the mist turns everything to pearl and silver, her pale eyes the only point that holds the light. Expression: pale fog-grey eyes narrowed and cold, a tight little smirk, wholly sure of herself.

people.imagined: After a lost round, at the edge of the forest, he combs his parting back into place with his fingers. A few frost-bitten toes stiffen under the wrap on one foot; he pretends he has not been beaten.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the forest's edge, he combs a hand across his hair to straighten his parting and looks at the viewer with an overly composed face. Face: a perfectly neat, ruler-straight side parting in glossy black hair, a small wooden comb in hand; a handsome, narrow, tidy face, smooth high forehead, thin line of mouth, ambitious light-brown eyes held too level, a small tic in the jaw; a small crescent of dried mud on his cheekbone. Hair: glossy black, oiled, bound in a precise topknot with a silver pin. Body: slim, upright, a stiffness in the left leg; he favours the left foot, bandaged under the boot. Clothing: an inner disciple's grey-green silk robe brushed clean, crossed collars with a single round pewter button, silver mist-curl borders, a pale grey silk scarf wound twice round his neck, the hem stained with bog water to the knee, boots cracked at the toes; a bamboo hat held under one arm. Hands and objects: the comb in his right hand; in his left a peg of dark wood with a cord. Power: a faint green shimmer of Wood qi clings to the peg. Background: white mist rolling over dark wet grass and dark pines, a few wooden pegs leaning crookedly in the bog. Light: pale silvery morning light from the upper left, evenly diffuse, so that nothing shines but the pewter button and the sheen of the silk. Expression: composed over wounded pride.

people.imagined: On the Đồng Sơn road with a fellow guard who is cursing the ridge. He listens, rubbing the boar-tusk charm with his thumb because someone just said a lie, and wears a careful blank face.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a road post at grey dawn, he rubs a charm with his thumb and looks sidelong at the viewer, careful and still. Face: a wary, lean, sun-browned face, wiry patchy stubble on a narrow jaw, a pale scar through one eyebrow, a crooked nose, a healed notch in the upper lip, a missing front tooth, black eyes ringed with fine lines that slide sideways. Hair: tangled dark brown, cut short with a knife and held with a rag and a stub of cord. Body: lithe, narrow, balanced on the balls of his feet. Clothing: an outer disciple's plain but clean silk, a grey-green robe borrowed and a little large, sleeve pinned up with a bone pin, stiff with dried mud at the hem, over a tunic cut from three borrowed greys, with a single faint silver mist curl at the collar; leather wrist wraps, straw sandals, a short bone-handled knife in the sash. Hands and objects: a small curved boar-tusk charm, yellow-white and finger-long, rubbed shiny, held in a closed fist on its dark cord; a short pole with a lantern in his left hand. Background: a pole lantern burning at a bend in the road, a pile of grey stones, a dark ridge of scrub, the first pale line of dawn, thin mist. Light: cold even silver-grey dawn with a warm spot of lantern light on one cheek and the polished yellow of the tusk, a faint green Wood glint in the mist. Expression: cautious, giving nothing away.

people.imagined: At a milestone at night with a folded page in his sleeve. He has read it, and the mace scar over his brow is pale in the lantern's glow; the thin wrists stick out of the cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a milestone at night, he holds a folded paper to his chest and stares past the viewer, jaw tight. Face: a long, pale, jagged mace scar curving over the left eyebrow, shiny and raised, splitting the brow in two; a thin young face, hollow cheeks, narrow chin, dark eyes bright with a cold grievance, chapped lips, a boyish fuzz on the chin and a silver-white seam of old burn along the jaw below the ear. Hair: black, short and uneven, a long fringe across the scarred brow. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, wrists sticking out of cuffs a size too short. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey-green silk of an outer disciple, a robe too big at the shoulders and pinned at the neck with a thorn, a clean grey under-robe a size too small, one thin silver mist curl at the collar, a leather strap across the chest holding a thin satchel; a hat hanging at his back. Hands and objects: a small folded paper held tight in his right hand; his left grips a lantern pole. Background: a milestone cut with nested curved lines like waves of mist, a long straight road between black pines to a thin pale line of sky, drifting motes. Light: a single warm lantern from the upper left lighting the scar and the glitter in his eyes, deep indigo spirit-light on the road behind, a faint blue Water shimmer in the mist. Expression: vengeful, tight, suspicious.

people.imagined: Carrying a lantern on the Phù Kiều road at dusk. She has stopped to rest her hands and holds them up to look at the blisters; she isn't angry at anyone and her face is quiet.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a riverside road, she holds her two open hands up before her, palms toward the viewer, looking at them, and then up with a gentle smile. Face: rings of pale, shiny lantern blisters round every finger, each finger ringed like a small band, plainly visible; a soft round young face, a gentle small nose, a warm mouth, big dark forgiving eyes with a bruise-brown shadow under them, a faint dusting of freckles, lashes wet as if she has just wept and stopped, a small rice-powder smudge on her chin. Hair: black, in a single long braid over one shoulder with a green thread tied in it. Body: slight, small, soft shoulders. Clothing: an outer disciple's plain graceful silk, a grey-green robe a size large hanging open, silver mist-curl borders faint at the hem, stained by river water, a plain grey under-robe, a little green cord at her throat with a lotus-seed bead; a bamboo hat pushed back. Hands and objects: a pole lantern with a frosted shade stands against her shoulder, lit. Background: a willow drooping over a slow green river, a low arched stone bridge, a milestone with a pale carving, a pole lantern by the road, soft motes. Light: soft amber lantern light from the upper left, deep violet dusk with a strip of orange at the horizon, a faint blue Water glow on the river mist. Expression: a gentle, quiet smile with soft eyes, no anger at anyone.

people.imagined: Kneeling at a milestone in spring, he has recut the seal again and is checking the chisel edge. It slipped, just now, and he is looking at the line, afraid.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a half-carved milestone in spring, he looks up with a worried frown from a chisel in his hand. Face: a plain, honest, round face, thick brows, a flat nose, grey stone dust whitening hair and cheeks; worried brown eyes red from stone grit; a small cut on his lower lip, bitten raw; a pale line of dried sweat through the dust on his cheek. Hair: brown, short, so thick with dust that he looks aged forty years. Body: stocky, broad hands, kneeling. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful silk, a grey-green robe with the sleeves tied back above muscular forearms and the hem folded under his knees as a cushion, grey with dust, faint silver mist curls at the borders, a plain sash; no apron, only a canvas roll of spare chisels beside him. Hands and objects: the heel of his right hand shows several short pink healed chisel nicks in a row; in his hands a steel chisel and a wooden mallet; before him a pale grey milestone with a half-cut round mist-seal of nested curved lines. Power: a few ochre motes of Earth qi lift from the fresh grooves. Background: the milestone chest-high and slightly crooked, a roadside bank of green fern and dark pines, soft mist. Light: bright gentle spring light from the upper left with a silvery glow, a bright glint on the chisel edge, sharp shadows in the carved grooves. Expression: diligent and anxious.

people.imagined: At the quarry in glare, a stone slab before him, which he has been told to carve and has chosen instead to leave. He squints at the one he fancies. Dust whitens his lashes.
people.subject: The moment: at a quarry in glare, a stone slab before him, he squints hard at the viewer, a mallet resting on his shoulder. Face: pale stone dust plainly frosting both eyelashes and eyebrows white, as if lined in frost; a permanent squint, one eye nearly shut, deep crow's feet; a long dour face, dust-grey stubble, a hooked nose, a downturned mouth, deep vertical furrows between the brows, large slightly red ears, fine dust settled in each wrinkle. Hair: black, cropped, whitened with dust. Body: lean, hunched, thick forearms, legs apart and back arched against the glare. Clothing: an outer disciple's plain graceful grey-green silk, the robe hitched through the sash on one side to free the leg, sleeves tied back, faint silver mist curls at the borders pale with dust; boots scuffed white; at his hip a pouch of pegs and a plumb line with a small lead weight. Hands and objects: a mallet in his right hand, a short chisel; a half-carved milestone beside him with a spiral seal. Power: a faint ochre shimmer of Earth qi in the dust. Background: a quarry wall of pale grey stone cut in great steps, rough blocks, a slab waiting on rollers, a hazy blue-white sky. Light: bright bleaching spirit-light from the upper left so that the stone, dust and white lashes merge into one glaring pale, a hard black shadow of his hat under the chin. Expression: dour, arbitrary, absorbed.

people.imagined: At the guards' spring dinner, pouring tea from a big gourd into cups, talkative and cheerful, a tea-stained lip. She is counting in her head what she still lacks for the terrace.
people.subject: The moment: at the guards' spring dinner she pours tea from a big gourd into cups, chattering happily to the viewer. Face: a brown tea stain at one corner of her lower lip, plain and visible, like a drip; a round, cheerful, freckled face, a button nose, quick merry hazel eyes, a gap in her front teeth, plump cheeks flushed from steam, short curling lashes, a tiny dimple in the left cheek. Hair: brown, in two high buns tied with green bamboo-leaf silk ribbons. Body: small, quick, plump, bouncing slightly with one hip against the table. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful silk, a light grey-green robe with silver mist curls at the cuffs, sleeves tied back with a green ribbon, a fine splash of brown tea on the front; a bamboo hat hanging at her back. Hands and objects: a large pale gourd tilted, a brown stream falling into a clay cup; a wooden tray of cups. Power: a thread of green Wood qi rises with the tea steam. Background: a long table with rows of clay cups and baskets of rice balls, guards in grey-green laughing, paper lanterns strung across the beams, a cooking fire glowing, soft motes of light. Light: warm lantern and fire glow with gold on the wet curve of the gourd and the stream of tea, a soft silvery rim on her hair. Expression: a bright, chatty grin with merry hazel eyes.

people.imagined: Mid-afternoon, over her tea pot. She has yawned into its steam and her eyes are closing; the second pot has been forgotten and the tea is weak.
people.subject: The moment: mid-afternoon over a teapot, she yawns wide, eyes closing. Face: a huge yawn, mouth wide open, eyes squeezed shut, steam curling across her face; a soft, round, sleepy face, a small snub nose, heavy lids, smooth tan skin, a slack cheek pillowed on her fist, steam beading her lashes, a small pink crease from the sleeve across her cheek. Hair: brown, coming loose from a lazy bun, a silver-green bamboo pin hanging by a single strand. Body: soft, slumped, leaning on the table. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful silk, a grey-green robe left open over a grey under-robe with a crumpled crossed collar, silver mist-curl borders, wide sleeves sliding down her arm; a bamboo hat dangling by its silk cord. Hands and objects: a round clay teapot with a thin plume of steam; a small cup half full of pale tea. Power: a drowsy green drift of Wood qi curls in the steam. Background: a rough shelf with clay pots, bunches of dried leaves hung from the rafters, a basket of tea buds, a window showing a green terrace. Light: warm hazy afternoon light from the upper left turning the steam into a golden veil, with a soft glow along her cheek. Expression: half asleep and unembarrassed, her whole face gone slack and comfortable.

people.imagined: In the lantern cellar, trimming wicks, a cough catching in his throat from the smoke. He has soot ringed round his eyes like a badger and is beaming up at the viewer, unaware.
people.subject: The moment: in the lantern cellar, trimming wicks, he looks up with a happy trusting grin, coughing into his shoulder. Face: thick black lamp-soot rings round both eyes, a dark mask like a badger's against a pale face; a thin, narrow face, big shining dark eyes, a long neck, an eager open mouth, a long streak of soot from the temple across the cheek, dark-dusted nostrils, dry cracked lips. Hair: black, fine, flopping over his forehead. Body: thin and frail, narrow chest, shoulders raised in a cough. Clothing: the robes of the founder's grandson, though still those of an outer disciple: a grey-green silk robe too big for him, held up with a cord at the neck, soot-grey inner layers with black thumbprints at the collar and cuffs, faint silver mist curls at the borders, a small brass key on a cord at his neck. Hands and objects: in one hand tiny silver scissors, in the other a lantern with green panes, the flame wavering. Background: a low arched stone ceiling, shelves of lanterns of many shapes, jars of oil, a ladder to a square of grey daylight, soot hanging as faint haze. Light: lamp glow warming his face orange, the green panes throwing soft green on the wall behind him, a faint blue Water shimmer at the lantern's edge. Expression: a sunny, trusting grin with big shining eyes ringed in soot, unaware of the mask.

people.imagined: The Đồng Sơn road in 1050, the year of founding: he has just hung the first mist lantern at the crossroads and stands back to look at it, a carter's son pleased with the light.
people.subject: The moment: at a crossroads in 1050, he has hung the first lantern on its post and steps back with a quiet smile, looking up at it. Face: a lined, kindly, long-jawed face weathered by river and road, a high narrow forehead, a wide generous mouth with uneven teeth and one crooked canine, a long grey-streaked beard to the chest, a nose crooked at the tip, tender lively dark eyes, deep sun creases from each eye, a small white scar across the top of his left hand. Hair: grey-black, long, in a plain knot under a bamboo hat pushed to the back of his head. Body: tall, lean and loose, with an easy stoop. Clothing: a founder's robe, though worn with humility: long layered mist-grey gauze over grey-green silk, spotless, collars crossed three deep and embroidered with silver mist curls, wide sleeves falling in long folds, a plain silk cord tied in a simple knot, river mud at the hem, a silver lantern pin; no other jewellery; straw sandals. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a long pole whose head carries a lantern of black pine and horn panes. Power: a soft grey-white aura of mist about his shoulders, a gold glow from the lantern on his weathered cheek. Background: a long pale road into mist between pines, an uncarved milestone, a little river glinting at the foot of the hill. Light: painted as an old memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened, fine cracks, soft grey light from the upper left. Expression: a quiet, pleased smile, tender eyes lifted to the lantern, soft and content.

people.imagined: The Đồng Sơn road, the night of 1190, holding the mist. He stands with an arm raised, calm, the mist streaming from his sleeve and a child behind him, his voice about to give him away.
people.subject: The moment: alone on a dark road in the night of 1190, he raises one arm and looks forward steadily, a calm stranger holding mist, a child behind him. Face: a calm, square, plain face, a short dark beard, steady quiet dark eyes, a faint smile at the corner of the mouth, one deep line between the brows, a small scar notching the left eyebrow, a weary shadow under each eye, sweat at the temples; ordinary brown skin. Hair: black, tied back under a bamboo hat. Body: sturdy, square, planted, the left foot a half step forward as if shielding someone. Clothing: an inner disciple's grey-green silk robe flaring from the raised arm, mist-dark at the hem, silver mist curls along the borders, a plain dark-grey under-robe, sandals tied with grass rope; the hat's cord hangs loose at his shoulder. Hands and objects: from his raised right sleeve a stream of pale white mist pours and curls; his left hand holds a lantern pole with a dim lantern. Power: the mist glows white from within, with a faint blue-green shimmer of Water and Wood, strong for a Trúc Cơ cultivator. Background: the pale shape of a small child crouched at a milestone just visible in the mist, the dim yellow of a distant lantern. Light: painted as an old memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened, fine cracks, dull amber lantern light on the side of his face. Expression: a steady, quiet resolve, weary but unafraid, with a hint of private amusement at his own nerve.
